caption: The drawing depicts a metal candlestick holder with a round base, a central vertical cylindrical shaft, and a curved handle attached to the side. The base is wide and flat, slightly concave, and supports the candle holder, which has a hollow center for holding a candle. The cylindrical shaft rises vertically from the center of the base and features a vertical slit through which a small ring is inserted, possibly for adjusting the height of the candle. The metal surface is rendered in brown and dark green hues, indicating an aged or patinated finish. The handle is attached to the side of the shaft, arching outward and upward. The composition is centered on the page with the object positioned against a plain, off-white background, and the word "FRANKLIN SYKES" is inscribed in small letters to the right and slightly below the base of the candlestick holder.
title: Candlestick and Holder
